description: This file defines an internal interface IStressTestGrain for a grain in Orleans, specifying methods for tests and communication with grains within a test suite.

methods.name: GetLabel
methods.description: Retrieves the label associated with the grain.

methods.name: SetLabel
methods.description: Sets the label for the grain.

methods.name: PingOthers
methods.description: Pings other grains identified by their IDs.

methods.name: LookUpMany
methods.description: Performs a lookup of many grains based on the provided addresses and IDs.

methods.name: Echo
methods.description: Echoes the data back from the grain.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Sends a ping with the given data.

methods.name: PingWithDelay
methods.description: Pings the grain with data after a specified delay.

methods.name: GetGrainReference
methods.description: Gets a reference to the grain itself.
